extracts.lead_summary: The line broke on a close. XLI fell 1.9% to $164.62, under the $166.18 October low that had held on every close for two weeks — its lowest close since Apr 7 and a sixth weekly close under the 200-day. The prints were good and the stocks were sold anyway. GE Aerospace beat, raised its 2026 EPS guide to $8.00–8.10 and fell 9.0% on the week on free cash flow and a slower 2027 services outlook. GE Vernova fell 10.6% Thursday after Meta's capex update revived AI-financing worries, and -11.5% on the week. CAT -6.0% to its lowest close since March, Parker -8.6%, Eaton -6.4%. Lockheed beat, raised and posted a record $292B backlog: +9.4%. CSX beat on record revenue: +4.3%. Nine of seventeen names rose; the five that fell hardest carry the weight.
